market_logic.context: the first accepted auction suspends any older context, preventing stale trades while persistence is unresolved
market_logic.failure_handling: a nonpersistent next auction resets the first state; it is not silently extended over a convenient gap
market_logic.impact: flow persistence alone is not direction; each enabled auction must realize direction-consistent displacement per residual flow
market_logic.sequence: persistent directional order flow is informative only when liquidity does not fully neutralize it and a separate following auction continues price discovery

selection_rule: fixed ex-ante priority among eligible variants passing the existing complete first-week gate; only the unchanged selected configuration may open both sealed weeks
